rounds.hypothesis: Minimize sum_C choose(np_C,2) under variable sign flips. Starting with no flips, run12 coordinate passes in local first-appearance variable order; flip only on strict reduction. Divide final violated pairs by sum_C choose(width_C,2).

J_ij=sum_C 2^-width_C sign_i sign_j over distinct variable pairs. Start all spins+1;12 greedy coordinate sweeps minimize sum J_ij s_i s_j, flipping only on strict decrease. Return |J| mass with J_ij s_i s_j>0 divided by total |J|.
For the same raw J, return sum_{J_ij<0}|J_ij|/sum|J_ij|. No spin or gauge optimization.
Fraction of F* clause rows whose sorted all-literal negation also appears in F*. Duplicate rows remain in the fraction; an empty clause is its own complement.

Set each variable to its F* majority sign, ties true. Start S=all active variables; synchronously remove every S variable in any clause touched by S but unsatisfied by all S-assigned literals. At most128 passes; verify every remaining touched clause is satisfied. Return |S|/n.
Compute exact maximum clause-variable bipartite matching on F*. Return(m-matching_size)/m; empty clauses are unmatched rows, without adopting a SAT answer.

Greedily pack variable-disjoint clauses by(width,original clause ID). Greedily hit uncovered clauses by maximum uncovered occurrence, ties lowest original variable ID. Return(cover_size-packing_size)/m.
Use16 normalized sparse J power steps, starting x_i=sin(1.7*(i+1)). Let h_i=-sum_C sign_i2^-width_C. Return|dot(x,h)|/||h||, where x is unit norm.

Starting x=.5,64 projected subgradient steps minimize sum_C max(0,1-sum_l truth(l))+.05sum_i(x_i-.5)^2-h_i*x_i, h_i=(pos_i-neg_i)/degree_i. eta=.05/sqrt(t+1)/sqrt(maxdegree); clip[0,1]. Return mean(x-.5).

Uniform prior;12 synchronous OR-factor sweeps damped.5. Factor-to-variable log odds are sign(l)*[-log(1-product(other literal false probabilities))]; cavity excludes that factor. Clamp probability to[1e-9,1-1e-9] and log odds to[-20,20]. Return mean(2*p_i-1).
